awards.name: Vanderbilt Owen MS Finance Merit Scholarships
awards.description: All MS Finance applicants are automatically considered for merit-based scholarship at admission. Awards based on academic achievement, potential for excellence in a management career, leadership potential, application strength, and potential to contribute to the Owen community. Scholarships cover partial tuition; amount announced at admission. Owen does not offer need-based scholarships.
awards.eligibility: Admitted Vanderbilt Owen MS Finance students. Page does not restrict by citizenship. Distinct from Owen Full-Time MBA merit / Dean's Scholars (SCH-051).
awards.amount: Partial tuition (amounts not published; notified at admission)
awards.note: overlapsWithExisting SCH-051 is MBA-only — do not merge. LatAm partner loan-scholarships (GUATEFUTURO / FUNED / HONDUFUTURO) on same page are nationality-specific, not HK/TW/PRC — brief only.

awards.name: Rochester Simon Full-Time MS Merit Scholarships (incl. MS Finance)
awards.description: Simon states more than 90% of incoming full-time MS students receive merit-based scholarship support. Admissions Committee determines awards when reviewing the MS application — no additional scholarship application. Award amount included with admission offer; amount is guaranteed and set aside for MS studies. Merit consideration available throughout all application rounds (funds diminish later but remain for highly competitive applicants).
awards.eligibility: Admitted Simon Full-Time MS students including MS in Finance. Page does not restrict by citizenship.
awards.amount: Not published (majority of class receives support; notified with offer)
awards.note: Partner-school guaranteed minimum $10k/year and UR undergrad 40% guarantee are US-pathway awards — see ingest:false cards. Teach For America $20k guarantee is TFA-specific — skipped as SCH.

sources.label: Simon Full-Time MS Tuition & Financial Aid

awards.name: Rochester Simon Evans Lam George Eastman Circle Scholarship
awards.description: Established through support of Evans Lam ’84S (MBA). Awarded to five outstanding full-time MS students each year at the time of enrollment via a pool and match approach.
awards.eligibility: Outstanding full-time Simon MS students (includes MS Finance). Citizenship limits not stated on page.
awards.deadline: At enrollment (no separate public application described)
awards.note: Named award distinct from general auto merit (SCH-097).

sources.label: Simon Full-Time MS Tuition & Financial Aid — Evans Lam

awards.name: ASU W. P. Carey MS-FIN Scholarships
awards.description: W. P. Carey awards a limited number of scholarships based on academic performance, leadership activities, community involvement, and future goals. Extremely competitive. A short application is required after admission has been awarded. Domestic and U.S. permanent residents must complete FAFSA. Page also lists graduate assistantships and loans as possible solutions; GA details are unit-posted, not MS-FIN-specific amounts.
awards.eligibility: Admitted W. P. Carey MS-FIN students who complete the post-admit scholarship application. Citizenship not restricted in scholarship paragraph; FAFSA required only for domestic/PR. Distinct from ASU Full-Time MBA 'Scholarships for All' (SCH-031).
awards.amount: Limited; amounts not published on MS-FIN page
awards.deadline: After admission (short application); apply early in cycle for competitiveness
awards.note: overlapsWithExisting SCH-031 is MBA-only — do not merge. CFA Program Awareness Scholarships (3/year) are exam-fee awards, not degree tuition — skipped.

sources.label: W. P. Carey MS-FIN Cost & Financial Aid

awards.name: UC Irvine Merage Master of Finance Scholarships
awards.description: Merage School offers scholarships to help finance graduate business education. All applicants are automatically considered during admissions; no separate application. Holistic review may include academic achievement, professional experience, leadership potential, and overall application strength. Availability and award amounts vary by program and cycle. Recipients notified as part of admissions. Program overview notes a majority of students receive scholarship awards. Early applications generally improve scholarship chances.
awards.eligibility: Admitted Merage Master of Finance students. Page does not restrict by citizenship. International students are separately directed to private loans/external scholarships for federal-aid gap.
awards.amount: Varies (majority of students receive awards; dollar amounts unpublished)
awards.deadline: With admission (Round 4 Apr 1 listed as scholarship priority deadline on admissions page)
awards.note: Round deadlines on Merage MFin admissions: R1 Oct 15, R2 Dec 1, R3 Feb 1 (intl recommended), R4 Apr 1 scholarship priority.

awards.name: Villanova School of Business MSF Merit Scholarships
awards.description: VSB offers merit scholarships to academically and professionally accomplished students. After admission, applicants submit a Scholarship Request Form via the Application Status Page. Holistic review of rigor of coursework, undergraduate GPA, standardized test scores, and professional background. Funding limited and first-come/first-served within the cycle — apply early. Typically one-time awards. Cannot be combined with MSF Fellowship (SCH-102).
awards.eligibility: Admitted Villanova MSF students who submit the Scholarship Request Form. International students are eligible for merit scholarships after admission (not eligible for federal aid).
awards.amount: Not published (varies; notified after request review)
awards.deadline: After admission via portal; funding limited — early rounds preferred (intl recommended Round 2 Jan 15)
awards.note: Fellowships cannot be combined with VSB merit scholarships.

awards.name: Villanova MSF Fellows Program (50% tuition + stipend)
awards.description: Graduate assistantship: fellows work 10 hours/week in fall and spring assisting VSB faculty research, and serve as Admissions Ambassadors at select events. Previous employment must be terminated by program start. In exchange: 50% tuition discount (remission of tuition and fees) plus a living stipend paid bi-weekly over fall and spring. Cannot be combined with any VSB merit scholarships — choose one.
awards.eligibility: Incoming Villanova MSF students who submit the MSF fellowship application. Explicitly available to international students per international students page.
awards.amount: 50% tuition discount + living stipend (stipend dollar amount not published)
awards.deadline: Separate MSF fellowship application (see fellowships page / admissions)
awards.note: Strong intl-relevant award among Batch2; stipend amount unpublished.

awards.name: Notre Dame Mendoza MSF Scholarships
awards.state: Automatic consideration; complete scholarship section in application
awards.description: Program-sponsored scholarships awarded via holistic review of the application. All applicants are automatically considered. Scholarship recipients expected to contribute actively to MSF and Mendoza communities. Scholarship decisions provided at admission. Complete the scholarship section within the application.
awards.eligibility: Qualified MSF candidates regardless of citizenship (explicit on Mendoza MSF page). International applicants strongly encouraged to apply by Round 2 for visa timing.
awards.deadline: With application scholarship section; rounds through Mar 17, 2027 (intl by Round 2 Jan 7, 2027 encouraged)
awards.note: Also mentions earned assistantships arranged with academic department (earnings for personal expenses; not a published MSF stipend package).

awards.name: UT Dallas Jindal MS Finance Cohort Scholarships
awards.description: Three levels of scholarship consideration available to high-achieving MS Finance Cohort students. Awards considered automatically at admission; applied toward tuition. Scholarships do NOT qualify students for in-state tuition. Cohort students are excluded from the general JSOM Graduate Scholarship portal (Dean’s Excellence / Impact / donor) — contact program director for options.
awards.eligibility: High-achieving admits to the MS Finance Cohort. Page does not restrict by citizenship. Distinct from UTD Full-Time MBA Guaranteed Merit (SCH-057).
awards.amount: Three unpublished levels (applied to tuition; does not create in-state rate)
awards.deadline: With admission application (foreign applicants deadline Apr 30; domestic May 31 on cohort page)
awards.note: overlapsWithExisting SCH-057 is MBA cohort — do not merge. General JSOM competitive scholarship ≥$1,000 can unlock in-state for non-TX/intl, but MS Finance Cohort is excluded from that portal.

sources.label: UTD MS Finance Cohort — scholarship levels

awards.name: Vanderbilt MSF Accelerator Alumni Scholarship
awards.state: For Accelerator® Summer Business Immersion participants
awards.description: Each year the Vanderbilt MS Finance program awards up to $5,000 in scholarship funding to participants of Vanderbilt's Accelerator® Summer Business Immersion.
awards.eligibility: Participants of Vanderbilt Accelerator Summer Business Immersion admitted to MSF. Rarely relevant for typical HK/TW/PRC external applicants.

awards.name: Rochester Simon Partner School / UR Undergraduate Guaranteed Scholarships
awards.description: Partner School Scholarships: graduates of 26 US partner undergraduate institutions receive priority consideration, waived application fee, and minimum $10,000/year merit for Simon full-time programs. University of Rochester undergraduates: guaranteed 40% tuition scholarship upon admission to Full-Time MS (fee waiver; GMAT/GRE generally not required).
awards.eligibility: UG degree from listed US partner schools, or University of Rochester undergraduate. Not a general international recruitment award.
awards.amount: Partner min $10,000/year; UR undergrad guaranteed 40% tuition
awards.deadline: With Simon MS application if pathway-eligible
awards.note: Research note / ingest:false for HK/TW/PRC slate.
